continuity.campaign_development: June 59 BCE: Valerius formalizes administration of the former bandit lands, advances the boundary survey without inventing an acreage figure, reopens organized trade through the lake-port holding, and begins moving restored agricultural output into regular commercial channels. The measured personal land total remains 4.25 square miles because the newly owned former bandit lands remain unsurveyed in aggregate.
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 square miles of measured pre-existing holdings; Round 42 adds 0.25 sq mi of confirmed acquisitions. Round 53 establishes ownership of all former bandit-held lands seized during the campaign, but their aggregate area remains unmeasured pending survey, so measured land_area_sq_miles remains 4.25 sq mi. Round 54 advances formal surveying but does not add a measured acreage figure.

character_registry.rule: Recurring named characters are persistent simulation entities. Established characters must be considered during every round and reused by name when contextually involved. Generic labels may be used only for genuinely unidentified groups or when no named individual is supported by prior continuity.

event_variety_policy.rule: Do not make every event about the same subject. Prefer distinct news dimensions supported by current state: military operations, intelligence, logistics, political relationships, economic/property activity, social/local developments, personal developments, geography, and reactions. Variety must arise from simulation context and must not be fabricated solely to fill slots.

exact_quantity_rule: Exact quantities retain their explicit units and are not converted into condition points.
